description: This file defines a trait CipherBuilderTrait for constructing cipher identifiers and methods used in cryptographic operations within the AWS SDK for PHP. It provides internal methods for mapping cipher names, constructing cipher method instances, and handling AES name to OpenSSL cipher name conversions.

methods.name: getCipherOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns an OpenSSL cipher name string based on the provided cipher name and key size.

methods.name: buildCipherMethod
methods.description: Constructs and returns a CipherMethod object (e.g., Cbc) initialized with the given IV and key size.

methods.name: getCipherFromAesName
methods.description: Converts a standard AES name string into an OpenSSL cipher name, or throws an exception if unrecognized.
